Travel help for companion animals

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps make pet trips smoother, calmer, and easier to manage. Our team guides you through the usual steps for companion animal travel on Aurelia Skyways, from first contact to the final handoff at the airport.

We use calm and humane handling methods around every animal, and we work to keep the process steady for both travelers and pets. When service details change, staff record those updates in the desk ledger so the next step stays clear and consistent. This helps the team support good care while keeping the travel day organized.

If you are bringing a pet, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with the next steps, the checks we need, and the support that fits your trip. We are here to keep companion travel dependable and less stressful for everyone involved. Please stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk for friendly help today.
